messages:
alex kim: Heads-up — noticed dashboard panel latency tail during a burst from the analytics job. Attaching a short flamegraph in the thread.
mira singh: Seen it too. Root cause looks like RBAC check RTTs to authz-service when telemetry enrichment is on for every query.
jon ramos: We instrumented telemetry inline previously to get full context, but that means authz gets extra payload + sync work. That path is hot.
alex kim: Proposal: decouple telemetry enrichment from the critical authz path. Two ideas: (1) sample telemetry at the gateway and send async to the collector, (2) keep a small RBAC policy cache (with invalidation hooks) so authz calls are avoided for common policies.
jon ramos: Agreed. Also per-tenant policy TTLs so we can have stricter TTLs for security-sensitive tenants and longer for low-risk ones.
sarah cohen: Tradeoffs: sampling reduces observability for regressions. Also long TTLs delay role revocation. Need a path to invalidate quickly when an admin flips a role.
jon ramos: We can expose an admin webhook that pushes cache invalidation events to the gateway. Also maintain an LRU keyed by (tenant, principal) and a short negative cache to prevent thundering herds.
alex kim: Quick pseudo-config idea:

```
# query gateway config (pseudo)
query_gateway:
  rbac_policy_cache_ttl: 20s
  rbac_policy_ttl_overrides:
    tenant: {
      "scale_co": 5s,    # high-risk tenant example
      "default": 20s
    }
  telemetry_sample_rate: 0.02
  telemetry_mode: async   # drop/enqueue enrichment from request path
```

mira singh: For the sample rate: 2% default looks reasonable for long-term metrics but we should have a 'capture-on-error' mode where sampled requests with authz failures include full telemetry.
alex kim: Exactly — low sample rate for steady-state, but if authz-deny or anomalies happen, flip to verbose capture for that session/trace.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pipeline queued: feature/telemetry-async -> staging (10% nodes). ETA ~ 15m.
devex: I'll update the docs to show per-tenant overrides and the admin invalidate flow. Also add a troubleshooting guide for when users report unexpected denies.
jon ramos: Measured numbers from a quick staging run: 95th latency for panel render dropped from ~420ms to ~180ms under synthetic burst. CPU on gateway dropped ~25%.
sarah cohen: Sounds promising. Need SLA note: policy cache TTL > 0 means small window for stale authz. Ops + Security ok with 20s? If not, implement forced invalidation on role changes.
mira singh: I will add a canary test that flips a role and measures end-to-end revoke delay. Alert rule: if revoke > 30s, page infra.
alex kim: Action items:
  1) RFC update: include invalidation hooks + per-tenant TTLs (owner: jon ramos)
  2) Add canary test and alerting for revoke latency (owner: mira singh)
  3) Devex doc for config + troubleshooting (owner: devex)
  4) Run 48h canary and collect error-capture telemetry for regression detection (owner: alex kim)
mira singh: I'll start the canary now and post the results in ~24h.
alex kim: sg, thanks team. Keep the verbose capture off for prod until we validate rollback triggers. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started on staging (10% traffic). Logs: gateway-telemetry-async/2026-03-20T12:02:10Z
alex kim: I'll follow up with a short RFC note and add the perf graphs.
